recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future changes to the gHGVS/genomic DNA change component should be made in HL7/genomics-reporting or the published Genomics Reporting IG unless Clinical Genomics explicitly moves this content back into FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-13835 asked to add Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange.Name as a 0..1 CodeableConcept for the gHGVS genetics DNA change using LOINC 81290-9. The final resolution said the spirit of the request was already applied in the Genomics Reporting IG at the described-variant genomic DNA change component.
initial_application: No current FHIR-core source contains Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange, DNAVariantChange, obs-described-variant, genomic-dna-chg, or LOINC 81290-9, and no FHIR-core git commit was found that directly mentions FHIR-13835. Clinical Genomics minutes approved FHIR-13832/FHIR-13833/FHIR-13835 together as already applied in the Genomics Reporting IG but not in Observation-genetics in FHIR Core; later core commits pointed genetics notes toward the IG and removed outdated clinical genomics artifacts.
additional_context: Current core keeps Observation in build scope but has no active Observation-genetics profile entry. Core genomics, Observation, and DiagnosticReport narrative delegates structured genomic reporting to the Genomics Reporting IG. The FHIR Extension Pack copy of observation-geneticsVariant is retired/deprecated with a standards-status reason saying it was replaced by the Genomics Reporting Guide. The current IG's Variant profile carries the evolved genomic-hgvs component with LOINC 81290-9, CodeableConcept value, required HGVS binding, and 0..1 component cardinality.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Restoring or adding Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange.Name in FHIR core would be outside current build scope and contrary to the accepted external-IG resolution.
